source.title: 2026 Fantasy Football ADP Analysis: Undervalued & Overvalued Wide Receivers

source.summary: Three receiver values and two fades

takeaways.label: value
takeaways.summary: A clear No. 1 role with Josh Allen, little competition and a strong improvisational fit are underpriced.
takeaways.rationale: A clear No. 1 role with Josh Allen, little competition and a strong improvisational fit are underpriced.
risks: Buffalo's target distribution can remain volatile.
